name: Grado SR325e Prestige Series Open-Back Wired Headphones
description: Grado Prestige Series SR325e open-back wired headphones — the classic hand-built, open-air sound out of Brooklyn, USA. The SR325e pairs Grado's iconic open-back design with a precision aluminum housing, delivering fast, forward, detailed sound with a punchy low end that's unmistakably Grado. Truly part of the Prestige line: dynamic and lively, great for rock, acoustic, and vocal-forward listening. Fully functional with both the 1/4-inch and 3.5mm cables, in good used condition — functional and working great with normal signs of use. Open-box design means they leak a little sound in quiet rooms, as open-back headphones do. Previously from a pet-friendly home (a cat lives here), but thoroughly vacuumed and wiped clean before listing. Does NOT come with an additional storage bag — please bring your own pouch for pickup.

name_zh: 歌德（Grado）SR325e Prestige 系列开放式有线耳机
description_zh: 转让歌德（Grado）Prestige 系列 SR325e 开放式有线耳机——美国布鲁克林手工打造的开阔开放式声音。SR325e 采用经典的开放式设计与精密铝合金壳体，声音快速、靠前、细节丰富，低频有冲击力，典型的歌德风：动态充沛、充满活力，非常适合摇滚、民谣与偏人声聆听。配件齐全（1/4 英寸与 3.5mm 耳机线各一），功能完好，成色 good，有正常使用痕迹。开放式设计在安静房间里会略微漏音，属正常特性。此前来自养猫的家庭，发布前已彻底吸尘清洁。不附带额外收纳袋，自提请自备小袋。
